hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [[ "$f" =~ /src/.*\.(ts|tsx)$ ]] || exit 0; cd /Users/personal/Ketu/application && OUT=$(npx eslint "$f" --max-warnings 0 2>&1); [ -z "$OUT" ] && exit 0; jq -n --arg c "ESLint issues in $(basename "$f"):\n$OUT" '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":$c}}'

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [[ "$f" =~ /src/(services|lib)/[^/]+\.ts$ ]] || exit 0; b=$(basename "$f" .ts); d=$(dirname "$f"); t="$d/__tests__/$b.test.ts"; [ -f "$t" ] || exit 0; cd /Users/personal/Ketu/application && OUT=$(npx jest "$t" --no-coverage --passWithNoTests 2>&1 | tail -8); jq -n --arg c "Jest ($b):\n$OUT" '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":$c}}'
cd /Users/personal/Ketu/application && STAT=$(git status --short 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$STAT" ] && exit 0; jq -n --arg m "Uncommitted changes:\n$STAT" '{"systemMessage":$m}'
